job.job_description:
Build and harden agentic systems that run in production for real clients. You will own the parts that make AI trustworthy: evals, guardrails, monitoring, and the human-in-the-loop layer.
What you will do
Design and ship LLM and agent features end to end, from prototype to production
Build eval suites that turn accuracy into a number tracked per release
Add guardrails, cost controls, permissions and monitoring around models
Work directly with clients: understand the workflow, scope the bet, ship the system
What we look for
Strong Python or TypeScript, and comfort across the full stack
Hands-on experience taking an LLM or ML feature to production
A bias for measurement over vibes, and for shipping over slideware
Clear written communication (we work with global clients, async)


Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
